# Approved alt text

## Landscape key art

An elevated midnight view of a model coastal city. A cyan route and an amber
route trace different paths through the same streets and infrastructure while
paper maps and translucent causal diagrams surround the city.

## Portrait key art

A coastal city at night emerges from layered municipal maps. Two luminous
routes cross different parts of the city and meet at one small record marker,
with archival cards and causal diagrams below.

## Afterimage mark

Two curved paths converge toward one ring, representing distinct causal
histories becoming a single public record.

## Social cards

The Afterimage title and launch line appear over a dark midnight model of a
coastal city crossed by two differently shaped causal routes.
